fields.label: Bot token (Developer Portal → Bot → Reset Token)

setup.help: Create an application on Discord's Developer Portal, open its Bot page, turn on the Server Members and Message Content intents, then press Reset Token and paste the token here. Invite the bot to your server and drag its role above any role you want it to hand out.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the bot token by calling GET /users/@me. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

bot.getMe.title: Get Bot User
bot.getMe.description: Return the bot's own user (id, username). Call once per run so later steps can recognise the bot's own messages and skip them.

guild.get.title: Get Server
guild.get.description: Fetch a server (guild) by id with approximate member and presence counts.

channels.list.title: List Channels
channels.list.description: List every channel and category in a server, with id, name, type (0 text, 2 voice, 4 category, 15 forum) and parent_id. Use it to resolve a channel name to its id.

channels.get.title: Get Channel
channels.get.description: Fetch one channel or thread by id.

channels.create.title: Create Channel
channels.create.description: Create a channel in a server. type 0 is a text channel (default), 2 voice, 4 category, 15 forum. Give parentId to place it under a category.

name.description: Channel name, 1-100 characters, lowercase with dashes for text channels.

parentId.description: Category channel id to nest under.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

channels.update.title: Update Channel
channels.update.description: Rename a channel, change its topic, or move it under a category. Only the fields supplied change.

parentId.description: Category channel id to move under.

channels.delete.title: Delete Channel
channels.delete.description: Delete a channel or thread for good, with every message in it. Cannot be undone.

messages.list.title: List Messages
messages.list.description: Read a channel's or thread's recent messages, newest first (up to 100). Supply at most one of before, after, around (message ids). Each message carries author.id and author.bot; skip your own and other bots' messages when deciding what to answer.

before.description: Only messages before this message id.

after.description: Only messages after this message id.

messages.send.title: Send Message
messages.send.description: Post a new message to a channel or thread (up to 2000 characters). To answer a specific message use Reply instead, so members can see what you are answering.

content.description: Message text, up to 2000 characters. Mention a user with <@userId>, a channel with <#channelId>.

messages.reply.title: Reply to Message
messages.reply.description: Reply to one message in its channel or thread, quoting it. Use this to answer a member's question; your reply is what marks the question as handled.

channelId.description: The channel or thread id the message is in.

messages.edit.title: Edit Message
messages.edit.description: Change the text of a message the bot sent.

messages.delete.title: Delete Message
messages.delete.description: Remove one message from a channel. Give a reason; it appears in the server's audit log. Report the deletion in the mod-log channel afterwards.

reason.description: Audit-log reason, e.g. the rule broken.

messages.bulkDelete.title: Bulk Delete Messages
messages.bulkDelete.description: Delete 2 to 100 messages at once by id. Messages older than two weeks are rejected by Discord. Cannot be undone.

messages.pin.title: Pin Message
messages.pin.description: Pin a message in its channel (up to 50 pins per channel).

messages.unpin.title: Unpin Message
messages.unpin.description: Unpin a message in its channel.

messages.listPinned.title: List Pinned Messages
messages.listPinned.description: List the messages pinned in a channel. Pins are often the channel's own FAQ; read them before answering.

threads.create.title: Create Thread
threads.create.description: Start a public thread in a text channel, not attached to a message. Use Create Thread From Message to discuss a specific message.

autoArchiveMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before archiving: 60, 1440, 4320 or 10080.

threads.createFromMessage.title: Create Thread From Message
threads.createFromMessage.description: Start a thread under one message, keeping a longer answer out of the main channel.

channelId.description: The channel id the message is in.

threads.join.title: Join Thread
threads.join.description: Add the bot to a thread so it receives and can post there.

threads.leave.title: Leave Thread
threads.leave.description: Remove the bot from a thread.

threads.addMember.title: Add Thread Member
threads.addMember.description: Add a member to a thread.

threads.listActive.title: List Active Threads
threads.listActive.description: List every unarchived thread in a server.

threads.listArchived.title: List Archived Threads
threads.listArchived.description: List a channel's archived public threads, newest first.

before.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only threads archived before it.

reactions.add.title: Add Reaction
reactions.add.description: React to a message as the bot. emoji is the unicode character (👍) or a custom emoji as name:id.

emoji.description: Unicode emoji or name:id for a custom emoji.

reactions.remove.title: Remove Own Reaction
reactions.remove.description: Remove the bot's reaction from a message.

reactions.removeUser.title: Remove a User's Reaction
reactions.removeUser.description: Remove one member's reaction from a message (moderation).

reactions.clear.title: Clear Reactions
reactions.clear.description: Remove every reaction from a message.

reactions.list.title: List Reactions
reactions.list.description: List the users who reacted to a message with one emoji.

members.list.title: List Members
members.list.description: List a server's members in user-id order with their roles and joined_at. Requires the Server Members privileged intent on the bot. Page with after (the last user id seen). A member without the welcomed role has not been onboarded yet.

after.description: User id cursor; members with a higher id follow.

members.search.title: Search Members
members.search.description: Find members whose username or nickname starts with a string.

members.get.title: Get Member
members.get.description: Fetch one member of a server: user, nick, roles, joined_at, communication_disabled_until.

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Fetch a Discord user by id.

members.kick.title: Kick Member
members.kick.description: Remove a member from the server. They can rejoin with an invite. Give the rule broken as the reason.

members.timeout.title: Time Out Member
members.timeout.description: Mute a member until an ISO8601 time (at most 28 days ahead). Reversible with Clear Timeout. Give the rule broken as the reason.

until.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the timeout ends.

members.addRole.title: Add Role to Member
members.addRole.description: Give a member a role, e.g. the welcomed role after onboarding. The bot's own role must sit above the role given.

members.removeRole.title: Remove Role from Member
members.removeRole.description: Take a role away from a member.

roles.list.title: List Roles
roles.list.description: List a server's roles with id, name, position and permissions. Use it to resolve a role name to its id.

roles.create.title: Create Role
roles.create.description: Create a role. color is an integer RGB value; permissions is a permission bitfield as a string.

hoist.description: Show members separately in the sidebar.

permissions.description: Permission bitfield as a decimal string.

roles.update.title: Update Role
roles.update.description: Change a role's name, colour, hoist, mentionable or permissions. Only supplied fields change.

roles.delete.title: Delete Role
roles.delete.description: Delete a role from the server. Members lose it immediately. Cannot be undone.

bans.list.title: List Bans
bans.list.description: List banned users with the reason recorded for each.

bans.create.title: Ban Member
bans.create.description: Ban a user from the server, optionally deleting their recent messages. A person must approve this; post the case to the mod-log first.

deleteMessageSeconds.description: Delete the user's messages from the last N seconds (0-604800).

invites.list.title: List Invites
invites.list.description: List a server's active invite links with their code, channel, inviter and uses.

invites.revoke.title: Revoke Invite
invites.revoke.description: Delete an invite link so it stops working.

code.description: The invite code (the part after discord.gg/).

dm.open.title: Open Direct Message
dm.open.description: Open (or return) the bot's DM channel with a user. Then use Send Message with the returned channel id. Members who block DMs from server members cannot be reached this way.

events.list.title: List Scheduled Events
events.list.description: List a server's scheduled events with how many members are interested.

events.createExternal.title: Create External Event
events.createExternal.description: Schedule an event that happens somewhere other than a voice channel (a link or a place). Needs a start, an end and a location.

location.description: Where it happens: a URL or an address, up to 100 characters.

events.createVoice.title: Create Voice Channel Event
events.createVoice.description: Schedule an event held in one of the server's voice channels (entity_type 2). A stage-channel event needs entity_type 1, which this connector does not offer.

channelId.description: The voice or stage channel id.

events.update.title: Update Scheduled Event
events.update.description: Change an event's name, description, times or status (1 scheduled, 2 active, 3 completed, 4 cancelled). Only supplied fields change.

events.delete.title: Delete Scheduled Event
events.delete.description: Remove an event from the server. Interested members are not told. Prefer Update with status 4 (cancelled) so they are.

emojis.list.title: List Custom Emojis
emojis.list.description: List the server's custom emojis (name and id); react with them as name:id.

guilds.list.title: List bot guilds
guilds.list.description: List guilds joined by the bot. Pass the last returned guild ID as after to fetch the next page; stop on an empty page.

after.description: Return guilds after this guild ID.

id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

messages.get.title: Get message
messages.get.description: Read one accessible channel message. Content availability depends on bot permissions and intents.

id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

channel_id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

content.description: Message text; may be empty when access to content is restricted.

messages.create.title: Create text message
messages.create.description: Send a text-only bot message; requires SEND_MESSAGES. Mentions are suppressed. Content limit is 2000 characters.

content.description: Non-empty message text, up to 2000 characters.

id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

channel_id.description: Provider resource ID, preserved as a string.

content.description: Message text; may be empty when access to content is restricted.

normalized.post.create.title: Create normalized text post
normalized.post.create.description: Publish text and return the versioned appcall Post model. Send a text-only bot message; requires SEND_MESSAGES. Mentions are suppressed. Content limit is 2000 characters.

text.description: Non-empty message text, up to 2000 characters.

channels.listInvites.title: List Channel Invites
channels.listInvites.description: List invite objects for a channel. Requires MANAGE_CHANNELS.

channels.createInvite.title: Create Channel Invite
channels.createInvite.description: Create an invite for a channel. Requires CREATE_INSTANT_INVITE.

maxAge.description: Seconds until the invite expires; 0 never expires. Defaults to 86400.

unique.description: Do not reuse a similar invite.

targetType.description: Voice invite target type: 1 stream, 2 embedded application.

targetUserId.description: User whose stream to display when targetType is 1.

targetApplicationId.description: Embedded application id when targetType is 2.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

channels.editPermissions.title: Edit Channel Permission Overwrite
channels.editPermissions.description: Create or replace a permission overwrite on a channel for a role or member. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

overwriteId.description: Role or member id of the overwrite.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

channels.deletePermission.title: Delete Channel Permission Overwrite
channels.deletePermission.description: Delete a channel permission overwrite. Requires MANAGE_ROLES.

overwriteId.description: Role or member id of the overwrite.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

channels.triggerTyping.title: Trigger Typing Indicator
channels.triggerTyping.description: Show the bot as typing in a channel for about 10 seconds. Requires SEND_MESSAGES.

channels.listWebhooks.title: List Channel Webhooks
channels.listWebhooks.description: List webhooks for a channel. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.

channels.createWebhook.title: Create Channel Webhook
channels.createWebhook.description: Create a webhook in a channel. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS. Name is 1-80 characters.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

channels.follow.title: Follow Announcement Channel
channels.follow.description: Follow an announcement channel into a webhook channel in the bot's server. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS on the target.

webhookChannelId.description: Channel id that will receive the followed posts.

threads.listPrivateArchived.title: List Private Archived Threads
threads.listPrivateArchived.description: List a channel's archived private threads. Requires READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY plus MANAGE_THREADS.

before.description: ISO8601 timestamp; only threads archived before it.

threads.listJoinedPrivateArchived.title: List Joined Private Archived Threads
threads.listJoinedPrivateArchived.description: List archived private threads the bot has joined in a channel. Requires READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY.

threads.getMember.title: Get Thread Member
threads.getMember.description: Get a thread member object, optionally with the member guild profile.

threads.listMembers.title: List Thread Members
threads.listMembers.description: List members of a thread. Requires GUILD_MEMBERS privileged intent to include guild member objects.

threads.removeMember.title: Remove Thread Member
threads.removeMember.description: Remove a user from a thread. Requires MANAGE_THREADS unless removing the bot itself.

messages.crosspost.title: Crosspost Message
messages.crosspost.description: Publish a message in an announcement channel to following channels. Requires SEND_MESSAGES, plus MANAGE_MESSAGES to crosspost another user's message.

reactions.deleteEmoji.title: Delete All Reactions for Emoji
reactions.deleteEmoji.description: Delete every reaction of one emoji from a message. Requires MANAGE_MESSAGES.

emoji.description: Unicode emoji, or name:id for a custom emoji.

guild.update.title: Update Server
guild.update.description: Modify a guild's settings. Requires MANAGE_GUILD. Only supplied fields change.

explicitContentFilter.description: 0 disabled, 1 members without roles, 2 all members.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

guild.getPreview.title: Get Server Preview
guild.getPreview.description: Fetch a public guild preview (discoverable/community guilds). Does not require the bot to be in the guild when the preview is public.

guild.getVanityUrl.title: Get Server Vanity URL
guild.getVanityUrl.description: Get a guild's vanity invite code and uses. Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

guild.getWidget.title: Get Server Widget
guild.getWidget.description: Get the guild widget JSON. The widget must be enabled in server settings.

guild.getWidgetSettings.title: Get Server Widget Settings
guild.getWidgetSettings.description: Get whether the guild widget is enabled and which channel it uses. Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

guild.updateWidget.title: Update Server Widget Settings
guild.updateWidget.description: Enable or disable the guild widget and set its invite channel. Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

channelId.description: Invite channel id for the widget, or null to unset.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

guild.getWelcomeScreen.title: Get Welcome Screen
guild.getWelcomeScreen.description: Get a community guild's welcome screen. Requires MANAGE_GUILD if the screen is disabled.

guild.updateWelcomeScreen.title: Update Welcome Screen
guild.updateWelcomeScreen.description: Modify a community guild's welcome screen. Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

enabled.description: Whether the welcome screen is enabled.

description.description: Welcome screen description, up to 140 characters.

welcomeChannels.description: Up to 5 welcome channel objects with channel_id, description, and emoji_id or emoji_name.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

guild.getAuditLog.title: Get Audit Log
guild.getAuditLog.description: Fetch guild audit-log entries. Requires VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.

userId.description: Filter by the user who made the change.

before.description: Return entries before this audit-log entry id.

after.description: Return entries after this audit-log entry id.

guild.listIntegrations.title: List Server Integrations
guild.listIntegrations.description: List guild integrations (Twitch, YouTube, bots). Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

guild.deleteIntegration.title: Delete Server Integration
guild.deleteIntegration.description: Delete a guild integration. This also deletes associated webhooks and kicks the associated bot. Cannot be undone.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

guild.getPruneCount.title: Preview Member Prune
guild.getPruneCount.description: Count how many members would be kicked by a prune. Requires KICK_MEMBERS. Inactive means no login in the given days and no role unless includeRoles is set.

includeRoles.description: Comma-separated role ids whose members are also eligible.

guild.beginPrune.title: Begin Member Prune
guild.beginPrune.description: Kick inactive members. Requires KICK_MEMBERS. Cannot be undone. Set computePruneCount false on large guilds.

computePruneCount.description: Whether to return the number kicked. Defaults to true.

includeRoles.description: Role ids whose members are also eligible.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

guild.listVoiceRegions.title: List Server Voice Regions
guild.listVoiceRegions.description: List voice regions available to the guild.

guild.listWebhooks.title: List Server Webhooks
guild.listWebhooks.description: List webhooks for a guild. Requires MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.

guild.leave.title: Leave Server
guild.leave.description: Remove the bot from a guild. Cannot be undone. The bot cannot leave a guild it owns.

members.update.title: Update Member
members.update.description: Modify a guild member: nickname, roles, mute, deafen, or voice channel. Requires the matching permission for each field.

nick.description: New nickname, or empty to reset.

channelId.description: Voice channel id to move to, or null to disconnect.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

members.updateMe.title: Update Current Member
members.updateMe.description: Change the bot's nickname in a guild. Requires CHANGE_NICKNAME.

nick.description: New nickname, or empty to reset.

members.getMe.title: Get Current Member
members.getMe.description: Get the bot's guild member object, including roles, nick, and joined_at.

bans.get.title: Get Ban
bans.get.description: Get a guild ban for one user, including the reason. Requires BAN_MEMBERS.

bans.bulkBan.title: Bulk Ban Members
bans.bulkBan.description: Ban up to 200 users at once. Requires BAN_MEMBERS and MANAGE_GUILD. Cannot be undone.

reason.description: Audit-log reason shown to server admins.

events.get.title: Get Scheduled Event
events.get.description: Fetch one guild scheduled event, optionally with user count.

events.listUsers.title: List Scheduled Event Users
events.listUsers.description: List users subscribed to a scheduled event.

invites.get.title: Get Invite
invites.get.description: Resolve an invite code to its guild, channel, and optional expiration and counts.

code.description: Invite code, not a full URL.

withCounts.description: Include approximate member and presence counts.

guildScheduledEventId.description: Include this scheduled event on the invite.

entitlements.consume.title: Consume Entitlement
entitlements.consume.description: Mark a one-time consumable entitlement as consumed. POST /applications/{application.id}/entitlements/{entitlement.id}/consume returns 204 and takes no body.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

entitlementId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

entitlements.deleteTest.title: Delete Test Entitlement
entitlements.deleteTest.description: Delete an active test entitlement. DELETE /applications/{application.id}/entitlements/{entitlement.id} returns 204. Only test entitlements can be deleted.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

entitlementId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

users.deleteMyRoleConnection.title: Delete My Role Connection
users.deleteMyRoleConnection.description: Delete the current user's application role connection. Official route DELETE /users/@me/applications/{application.id}/role-connection. Requires the role_connections.write scope; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

commands.editPermissions.title: Edit Command Permissions
commands.editPermissions.description: Replace permission overwrites for one application command in a guild. PUT returns the guild application command permissions object. Discord requires a user bearer token with applications.commands.permissions.update; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

guildId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

commandId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

permissions.description: Up to 100 overwrites. Each item has id, type (1 role, 2 user, 3 channel), and permission.

commands.getPermissions.title: Get Command Permissions
commands.getPermissions.description: Fetch permission overwrites for one application command in a guild.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

guildId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

commandId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

commands.listPermissions.title: List Command Permissions
commands.listPermissions.description: Fetch permission overwrites for every application command in a guild.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

guildId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

gateway.get.title: Get Gateway
gateway.get.description: Return a Gateway WSS URL. GET /gateway does not require authentication and returns {url}. Cache the URL and call again only when a connection cannot be opened.

templates.get.title: Get Guild Template
templates.get.description: Return the guild template for a template code, including its serialized source guild.

templateCode.description: Template code, not a full URL.

users.getMyGuildMember.title: Get My Guild Member
users.getMyGuildMember.description: Return the current user's guild member object. Official route GET /users/@me/guilds/{guild.id}/member requires the guilds.members.read scope; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

guildId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

oauth2.getAuthorization.title: Get Current Authorization
oauth2.getAuthorization.description: Return the current OAuth2 authorization (application, scopes, expiry, and user when identify was granted). GET /oauth2/@me requires a bearer token; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

subscriptions.get.title: Get SKU Subscription
subscriptions.get.description: Return one subscription for a SKU by subscription id.

skuId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

subscriptionId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

users.getMyRoleConnection.title: Get My Role Connection
users.getMyRoleConnection.description: Return the current user's application role connection. Requires role_connections.write; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

users.listMyConnections.title: List My Connections
users.listMyConnections.description: Return the current user's linked third-party connections. Requires the connections scope; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

subscriptions.list.title: List SKU Subscriptions
subscriptions.list.description: List subscriptions that contain a SKU. user_id is required except for OAuth queries. before, after, and limit page the result (limit 1-100, default 50).

skuId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

userId.description: User id to filter by. Required except for OAuth queries.

stickers.listPacks.title: List Sticker Packs
stickers.listPacks.description: Return the standard sticker packs available to Nitro subscribers. The JSON body is {sticker_packs}.

users.updateMe.title: Modify Current User
users.updateMe.description: Change the current user's username, avatar, or banner. PATCH /users/@me accepts JSON image data URIs, not multipart. Omitted fields are left unchanged. A username change can randomize the discriminator and is heavily rate limited.

avatar.description: Image data URI to set the avatar.

banner.description: Image data URI to set the banner.

users.updateMyRoleConnection.title: Update My Role Connection
users.updateMyRoleConnection.description: Replace the current user's application role connection and return it. Requires role_connections.write; this connector still sends the configured bot token. Metadata values must be strings.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

platformUsername.description: Username on that platform, max 100 characters.

metadata.description: Metadata keys mapped to string values, each max 100 characters.

users.listMyApplicationEntitlements.title: List My Application Entitlements
users.listMyApplicationEntitlements.description: Return entitlements granted to the current user for one application, active and expired. Official route GET /users/@me/applications/{application.id}/entitlements returns a JSON array. sku_ids filters by SKU and exclude_consumed drops consumed items. Requires the applications.entitlements scope; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

applicationId.description: Discord snowflake, sent as a string.

skuIds.description: Comma-delimited SKU ids. Omit to return every entitlement for the application.

oauth2.getUserInfo.title: Get OpenID Connect UserInfo
oauth2.getUserInfo.description: Return OpenID Connect claims for the current authorization. Official route GET /oauth2/userinfo returns JSON, including sub and any email or profile claims the token grants. Accepts a bot token or an OAuth token with the openid scope; this connector sends the configured bot token.

oauth2.getPublicKeys.title: Get OAuth2 Public Keys
oauth2.getPublicKeys.description: Return the public keys used to verify OAuth2 tokens. Official route GET /oauth2/keys returns JSON with a keys array. Authentication is optional; this connector still sends the configured bot token.

publicKeys.description: JSON Web Key Set, with a keys array.
